mechanisms.definition: Independent random deletion at the target missing rate.
mechanisms.deployment_read: Neutral packet loss or randomly sampled telemetry dropout.
mechanisms.name: mcar
mechanisms.scope_guard: Control mechanism only; not an operational cause model.

mechanisms.definition: Contiguous channel-level missing spans with matched final rate.
mechanisms.deployment_read: Short sensor logging gaps or temporary channel outages.
mechanisms.name: block
mechanisms.scope_guard: Controls contiguity but not value dependence.

mechanisms.definition: Missing probability increases at high normalized values, then rate matching is enforced.
mechanisms.deployment_read: Storm, peak-load, congestion, or saturation-related missingness.
mechanisms.name: value_high
mechanisms.scope_guard: Synthetic proxy for value-dependent MNAR; not a causal claim.

mechanisms.definition: Missing probability increases with large local changes, then rate matching is enforced.
mechanisms.deployment_read: Failure during unstable regimes, transitions, or high-frequency variation.
mechanisms.name: volatility
mechanisms.scope_guard: Measures sensitivity to change-linked masks, not event detection quality.

mechanisms.definition: Contiguous time blocks remove many channels simultaneously with matched final rate.
mechanisms.deployment_read: Power/network outage, site-level telemetry loss, or shared infrastructure failure.
mechanisms.name: blackout
mechanisms.scope_guard: Does not model outage recovery dynamics beyond the encoder window.

mechanisms.definition: Selected channels disappear late in the sequence with matched final rate.
mechanisms.deployment_read: Permanent sensor retirement, meter replacement, or channel decommissioning.
mechanisms.name: retirement
mechanisms.scope_guard: Reported separately so the paper is not driven only by an obvious failure case.
